text: Stage 2 implementation is active. Exact-schedule ILP controls and dispatch-once primitive mutable loops are implemented; focused JVM/Scala.js laws are green and same-host JDK 25/JDK 21 benchmark receipts show large mutable-loop gains with allocation reduced from per-element growth to roughly constant per operation. Remaining before closure: finish the JDK 21 public-reduction receipt, regenerate parity gates, record before/after reports and documentation, and run the full project gate.
